401910101.text: As I said, let's wait until midnight. You can attend to other matters in the meantime.

401910201.text: Huh... Doesn't look like Miko is around here anywhere. Paimon doesn't see Ayato or Ayaka, either...

401910202.text: Are we too early? Hmm... Didn't Ayato say he prepared lodging for everyone at the shrine?

401910203.text: ...Did you hear? Someone encountered a doppelganger here last night!

401910204.text: A doppelganger!? You mean... like a doppelganger of themselves, or someone they know?

401910205.text: You know what they say... Anyone who sees their doppelganger will be replaced by them within three days..

401910206.text: Th—That's just a folk tale! It's not real!

401910207.text: #...Doppelgangers? That's a common folk tale in Inazuma, isn't it... Ever heard of it, {NICKNAME}?

401910209.text: Yeah, it's a pretty famous one, huh... A friend being replaced by a complete stranger!

401910212.text: Also, the timing is a bit too coincidental, don't you think? Could it be related to what we saw last night?

401910213.text: The whole doppelganger thing sounds kind of like what Sayu was talking about with Bunshin Phantasm... Maybe something went wrong with Kichiboushi's powers?

401910214.text: Well... Thinking about it isn't going to get us anywhere. Why don't we go check on Sayu's team?

401910217.text: Well, if it's Sayu we're talking about, that's definitely possible... Oh, someone's coming!

401910219.text: Weird... Is he here to work on the equipment? But, he doesn't look like any of the workers we saw yesterday... And, it doesn't seem like he's here for the games...

401910221.text: Ah... He snuck away again! Do you think he might be...?

401910222.text: Let's follow him and see what he does.

401910211.text: Huh? It always comes up in light novels... You've really never seen it? It's like when your friend is replaced by a complete stranger!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the area outside the venue

401912201.text: You quietly follow the man out of the festival grounds...

401912202.text: He's constantly looking back... Paimon's calling it now! Something fishy is going on!

401912203.text: Don't jump to conclusions. Let's keep watching.

401912204.text: Good point! He could be on his way to meet someone! Let the hunter become the hunted!

401912205.text: ...Reporting back, Ma'am. Nothing suspicious to note at the Bunshin Phantasm booth. It's possible there's no connection to the incident from last night.

401912206.text: I see... Did you find any other clues?

401912210.text: I was wondering who was daring enough to sneak up on one of our detectives. Maybe I should have expected it to be you.

401912214.text: F—Forgive me, ma'am! I have failed as a detective... I... I did not realize someone was on my tail...

401912215.text: #...Considering {NICKNAME}'s skill, the fault is not with you.

401912216.text: Uh... So, what's going on? What are you investigating? It must be serious if Heizou's involved...

401912218.text: ...Unfortunately... My orders prevent me from sharing that information with you.

401912219.text: Huh? What orders? You really can't tell us anything?

401912220.text: (If Sara and Heizou are so hesitant to divulge information... There's only one person who could be responsible.)

401912221.text: Those orders come from the Shogun, don't they...

401912226.text: No... I believe this is Ei.

401912227.text: ...You recognized me with a single glance?

401912228.text: Shogun, we still haven't completed the investigation...

401912229.text: #It matters not. I am certain the person standing before us is our friend, {NICKNAME}.

401912230.text: #{M#His}{F#Her} gaze, {M#his}{F#her} presence, {M#his}{F#her} mastery of several types of Elemental Energy... There is no mistake. And, we need {M#his}{F#her} help.

401912231.text: ...Understood. An investigation team was sent to survey a piece of land. Yesterday, the Tenryou Commission received a report that the team was found unconscious in the field.

401912232.text: ...Not only that, but the group appeared to have become trapped in an endless nightmare, unable to wake up.

401912235.text: We detected intermittent traces of youkai power where they were found. We followed the traces and ended up here, just outside the festival grounds.

401912237.text: Should we call off the festival?

401912238.text: Unfortunately, it's not that simple. You've heard the rumors about the doppelgangers, yes?

401912239.text: We suspect the culprit has the ability to change form, allowing them to spread misinformation at will. They may have already infiltrated the festival grounds.

401912240.text: If we call off the festival, we may give them a chance to escape amid the chaos...

401912241.text: Even the slightest movement could alert them. Locking down the festival grounds could provoke them to attack, which would endanger the public.

401912242.text: You're right... That's a big risk...

401912243.text: The purpose of festival is to bring humans and youkai together. We cannot allow the culprit to endanger anyone.

401912244.text: But, what if they attack again?

401912245.text: A very valid concern. Last night, we dispatched a group of soldiers to the festival grounds. They'll remain undercover to keep an eye on things.

401912246.text: We also blocked off several nearby roads under the pretext of construction, so we can keep civilians away as much as possible.

401912247.text: ...Even the Almighty Shogun has taken it upon herself to patrol the area all night.

401912248.text: Fortunately, no one else has been harmed.

401912250.text: Ah! So the thunder we heard was you!

401912251.text: ...I apologize for our failings, Shogun. You should not have had to intervene.

401912252.text: On the contrary, it was my decision. I was unable to capture the culprit last night, so I left to discuss a plan with Miko. I did not show myself once I saw you were safe, and for that, I apologize.

401912253.text: Ah, speaking of Miko... Where is she?

401912254.text: ...She is investigating the trace of youkai power found at the scene. Though it fades in and out, it never strays from Mt. Yougou.

401912255.text: Which means... if the culprit infiltrated the festival grounds, they must still be nearby.

401912256.text: The only people close to the grounds last night were the staff and the contestants staying at the shrine.

401912257.text: Miko is working with the Kamisato siblings to verify the identities of the staff members. They should be done soon.

401912258.text: As for the contestants... That inquiry must be performed by someone else.

401912259.text: ...Is that why you need my help?

401912260.text: ...The Tenryou Commission is too conspicuous. But as the judge of the competition, you can ask questions without arousing suspicion.

401912261.text: Okay, so you need us to talk to the teams and see if there's an imposter among us...

401912262.text: #Precisely. {NICKNAME}, I understand these people are your friends, and it puts you in a difficult position...

401912263.text: But, if one of them has indeed been displaced by a youkai, they could be in grave danger...

401912265.text: Thank you. I truly hope the situation is not as grave as it seems.

401912266.text: What are you guys gonna do next? Continue to investigate from a distance?

401912267.text: Well, there's only so much we can learn that way, so I think we need to find a way to slip onto the grounds. It's better for us to be at the scene if something goes wrong.

401912268.text: I fear the Shogun is far too revered a figure for that. If she arrives at the grounds, it will certainly cause a stir.

401912269.text: Worry not. Miko and I discussed that issue. She claims to have a plan. The preparations are underway as we speak.

401912270.text: One of her genius plans, huh...

401912272.text: ...Indeed. If you learn any details of said plan, I would like to know what I'm getting myself into.

401910401.text: *yawn*... So tired... I don't feel rested at all. How come you two have so much energy? Didn't you stay up even later than me...?

401910403.text: Kichiboushi! That's not a nice thing to say to a friend. Sayu's probably just tired because she came up with all the ideas yesterday!

401910404.text: Need a break, Sayu? I can start thinking about the ending stages in the meantime!

401910405.text: It's been forever since we've done something fun together! You need to have enough energy to enjoy it!

401910406.text: Oh, uh... I—It's okay... I can push through...

401910407.text: Sayu and Yoimiya seem the same as ever! Kichiboushi, too. How should we test them...?

401910409.text: Oh, good idea! Doppelgangers only mimic appearances — they wouldn't know about someone's past! Let's give it a try!

401910411.text: Whoa, you guys are here bright and early!

401910412.text: #Y—Yeah, well... {NICKNAME}'s judging this thing, so we can't slack off... right?

401910413.text: Still... You don't need to make anything, so what's the rush?

401910414.text: Yeah... If the people in charge are here early, that usually means there's been some kind of emergency...

401910415.text: #Oh, no... It's just... {NICKNAME} really wanted to see you!

401910418.text: Um... Well... It's... your game! Playing your game yesterday brought up a whole bunch of old memories!

401910419.text: So, we wanted to come early to reminisce about old times, hehe. Y'know, because you might be busy... later... and stuff...

401910420.text: (What kind of an excuse is that? They're busy now!)

401910424.text: Oh, you know what? Me too! I thought about adding them to our game, considering the "dream" theme and everything.

401910425.text: But, in the end, the ideas just wouldn't come together...

401910427.text: No, it's not a food! The Aranara are like, um... small youkai from Sumeru. They're super friendly and cute, and can give you good dreams...

401910428.text: Actually, that describes you, too, Kichiboushi. If you ever go to Sumeru, I'm sure you'll be considered a "good Nara"!

401910430.text: Sumeru, huh... The dreams there are supposed to be special. Did you witness a dream or something? Maybe it could give us some inspiration, and we wouldn't have to think so much...

401910431.text: #Haha... Sorry, that dream is a little... hard to describe, don't you think, {NICKNAME}?

401910432.text: Sometimes, when there are too many feelings in a dream...

401910433.text: It's really hard to use as reference material.

401910434.text: Alright... *sigh* I was just wondering what kind of dream it was, that's all...

401910435.text: I guess it was the kind where... a lot of things happened! Anyway, it's a long story. How about we wait until after the competition?

401910436.text: #...{NICKNAME} and I can tell it together.

401910468.text: After that, you share many more memories together...

401910469.text: Oh, shoot, where did the time go... We have so many levels to design today!

401910470.text: Oh, we should get out of your fur— hair, then! Good luck, everyone!

401910471.text: Bye, White Fur! Bye, Yellow Fur! Come back and play!

401910472.text: Wow, we've had so many adventures, huh... You don't even realize it until someone brings up the past.

401910473.text: Do you still remember the original meaning of our journey?

401910474.text: Oh, yeah, totally! It was, um... What was it again?

401910476.text: Anyway, Paimon didn't pick up on anything suspicious from that team... If anything, we were the weird ones, forcing conversations and stuff...

401910478.text: O—Okay, so maybe it wasn't the best strategy. Leaning into the "judge" angle is probably a safer bet...

401910479.text: Let's ask about the creative process behind the game and confirm their identities that way... Paimon saw Thoma's team show up just now. So, we can investigate them next!

401910439.text: Huh? Wh—Why are you bringing that up all of a sudden?

401910441.text: Reminded of the time you failed that ninjutsu technique...

401910442.text: Uh... Well, that was my bad... I tried to turn into a barrel, but my tail was sticking out... So, you found me immediately.

401910443.text: B—But this time, I'm not in charge of turning into things anymore, so it should be fine! I think...

401910445.text: Kichiboushi, what did I say about talking that way...? Anyway, you seemed to have a good grasp on transformations yesterday, Sayu... What's the story here...

401910446.text: It all started with a certain mysterious order...

401910447.text: Th—That one shouldn't be on me! I didn't realize I was tricked until later... Did all that work, and didn't even get to nap... Really shouldn't have taken that order...

401910448.text: Still... we had some fun times together, right?

401910450.text: Based on what happened, I guess... You could say that...

401910451.text: Whoa, I've never seen this look on Sayu's face... What the heck happened back then!?

401910453.text: No, I'm not! And, I'm not a Mujina!

401910455.text: Mm! Had fun with Yellow Fur!

401910456.text: We went to soooooo many places together!

401910458.text: Wow, you traveled to all those places together?

401910459.text: Orange Fur come with next time?

401910460.text: You betcha! You should come, too, Sayu! If you can find the time, of course!

401910461.text: Um... Would we have to walk there?

401910462.text: Nope! You can just sit on the boat and listen to stories. We'd be there before you knew it!

401910463.text: You can nap on the boat, too.

401910464.text: Let the waves rock you to sleep.

401910466.text: As long as Storm-Storm not mad...

401910467.text: Hey! It's not like Dvalin's the one behind every single gust of wind!

401910301.text: Hey, Thoma! We were hoping to learn a bit more about the philosophy behind your game. Is now a good time?

401910302.text: Ah, looks like our judges are hard at work this morning.

401910304.text: Oh, um... Boss can explain that one.

401910305.text: Boss and Shousei were up super late last night coming up with ideas!

401910306.text: And, he's back at it this morning, as energetic as ever! Boss is the best!

401910307.text: Oh, I don't deserve that much praise... But, when it comes to the "talking" part, I guess I'm the best person to answer your questions.

401910312.text: Oh, I'd have to say... working with others to overcome challenges...

401910313.text: #Hold on! You can't ask such a simple question, {NICKNAME}! Watch and learn...

401910314.text: *ahem*... We'd love to learn more about your design approach and strategic vision. What will be the project's main draw, and how will it deliver emotional value to your players?

401910316.text: Sounds like you took that question straight from one of those business experts in Ritou... In that case, let me say this...

401910317.text: This product will be a fast-paced, easy-to-digest release that capitalizes on the enduring popularity of a traditional genre while addressing its common pain points...

401910318.text: By reviewing our strengths and the needs of our players, we were able to synchronize them across production levels and provide a refined experience that is more receptive to our users and more enjoyable overall...

401910320.text: (You set yourself up for that one, Paimon!)

401910322.text: Haha... I kind of confused myself, honestly. I'm used to hearing that kind of talk in Ritou, so I guess I picked up a few things.

401910323.text: #A fixer is a tough nut to crack, huh... Shoot, Paimon can't pick apart an answer she doesn't understand! Over to you, {NICKNAME}!

401910340.text: You continue asking questions, and Thoma answers faultlessly...

401910341.text: ...So, there you have it. I hope that answered your question, judges.

401910325.text: Well... From a design standpoint, we want it to be a game for everyone...

401910326.text: Not so fast! "Everyone" isn't an answer! You need to be more specific about your target audience!

401910327.text: Ah... You're absolutely right. Then, allow me to revise my answer. Our target audience includes growing children, ages zero to eighteen.

401910328.text: Makes sense! Kids need a little exercise here and there!

401910329.text: Second would be active adults, ages eighteen to forty.

401910330.text: Right! Adults have more stamina, so they can get more out of the game.

401910331.text: Next would be older adults, ages forty to sixty, especially those in need of exercise.

401910332.text: Older adults... Hm, exercise is important for healthy aging, but something feels off about this...

401910333.text: Finally, we have elderly people who are still full of life. That would be the sixty to a thousand age range.

401910334.text: Ah, okay... Wait! That includes everyone!

401910335.text: Haha, well, we can't forget about the youkai, right? This game is for humans and youkai alike, after all.

401910337.text: (Because he's trapped in a statue, I'm guessing...?)

401910338.text: Besides, you seemed to agree with each group, Paimon... Unless you intend to change your tune?

401910501.text: Huh? White Fur and Yellow Fur are here early!

401910502.text: You're here alone? Huh... Where are Kokomi and the others?

401910503.text: Don't know about great youkai, but sole lady is behind you!

401910504.text: Sole lady? Oh, as in "Sole of the Deep"? Okay... Wait, did you say behind us!?

401910505.text: You have questions for me, I presume?

401910506.text: K—Kokomi! A little warning next time...

401910507.text: ...Sounds like you already know why we're here.

401910508.text: Yes, I heard about the Doppelganger incident. When I saw you around the venue just now, it wasn't hard to connect the dots.

401910509.text: As for what you want to know...

401910511.text: Energy...? Oh! The numbers you write in your diary—

401910515.text: So... we can leave it there, right? You don't need to ask any more questions, I would imagine...

401910517.text: As for Gyoubu Koban... He was in the shrine all night. I can't imagine he's the criminal you're searching for.

401910518.text: EH!? Gyoubu Koban is a criminal!?

401910519.text: N—No, of course not! You're in the clear!

401910523.text: What about Mizuki? Where did she go?

401910524.text: She left after receiving a message in the middle of night... Looking back on it, perhaps it's related to your own investigation.

401910525.text: Oh, as she left, I heard her whisper under her breath, "Ordering me around in the middle of the night. Who does she think she is...?"

401910527.text: (She probably needed an expert on nightmares to help formulate a strategy... Well, I guess that also confirms Mizuki's identity.)

401910528.text: Hm, something tells me a certain someone is missing me...

401910531.text: Did you finish up your work?

401910532.text: Yes, I left the rest to the young fellow from the Kamisato Clan. At least for now, there's nothing suspicious to note.

401910533.text: That means... the culprit didn't manage to sneak in? That's a relief...

401910534.text: Just like that, you let down your guard? And all it took was for me to wear her face...

401910538.text: Oh? Greedy little thing... I thought we agreed on twenty?

401910601.text: ...A—Almighty Shogun! Glory to your everlasting reign... I—I mean... Welcome, welcome!

401910602.text: This stall looks familiar. Yet, it would seem the ownership has changed hands...?

401910603.text: Ah... You must be thinking of Tomoki. H—He... wasn't feeling well today, so I'm filling in... haha...

401910604.text: I see... Yet, you remind me of someone — a Doushin from the Tenryou Commission...

401910606.text: What are you looking at, Ei?

401910607.text: Hm, the food offerings. Although, this vendor seems...

401910608.text: (The "vendor" is giving me a pleading look... Judging by his cooking skill, it almost seems like his first day on the job...)

401910611.text: ...I see. I appreciate your dedication, sir.

401910612.text: O—Of course! It's an honor to serve such esteemed guests!

401910613.text: No need for formalities... I'll take three orders of Dango Milk.

401910615.text: Three orders? So, Paimon gets one, too?

401910616.text: Yes, I wanted to thank you for accompanying me. Without you by my side, I imagine the people here would be on edge even now.

401910617.text: I have my reasons for being here, of course, but I would hate to tarnish the festive atmosphere.

401910620.text: Heh, indeed. The Mikawa Flower Festival... Hundreds of years have passed since I last partook in the festivities. Much is different this time — the people, the place, the games...

401910621.text: Yet, the name endures, and the joy of celebration along with it... I suppose that, in itself, is a form of Eternity.

401910623.text: Oh, Mizuki! Looks like you got some much-needed rest!

401910624.text: Yumemizuki Mizuki... Thank you for your aid earlier.

401910625.text: Of course, I'm always willing to help. It's my duty... I wish I could have dispelled the nightmares, but this situation is uncharted territory for me.

401910626.text: Even so, relieving the pain of the nightmares is no small feat. You honor the legacy of the Yumekui-Baku.

401910627.text: So, not even Mizuki could fix it... What's going on with this nightmare creature...?

401910629.text: ...Let's save the difficult questions for later. Actually, I came here to ask you something.

401910630.text: Wanna come to Aisa Bathhouse with me? Most of the contestants will be there... Oh, and don't worry about payment — it's my treat!

401910632.text: You want us to go to the hot springs... now?

401910633.text: Well, game development isn't easy. Most of the contestants are exhausted and could use a break.

401910634.text: You've been under a lot of pressure yourselves, with the investigation and all. So, I thought you might like to join.

401910636.text: ...I will remain here. I rarely have time away from Tenshukaku, and I would like to continue perusing the stalls.

subQuests.subQuestName: Invite Ei to the Aisa Bathhouse
Talk to Ei in the Aisa Bathhouse

401910801.text: ...Steam replete with the scent of orchids. Water that turns the complexion a blushing pink... So, this is a hot spring.

401910802.text: Is it your first time here?

401910803.text: Yes, there are Royal Hot Springs near Tenshukaku. But, the plans were set in motion only after Hiiragi Hiroshi introduced the Snezhnayan Blast Furnace to Inazuma, and that was five hundred years ago.

401910804.text: When the project was complete, I was already in the Plane of Euthymia... And, naturally, the body of the Shogun has no need for such luxuries.

401910806.text: The members of the Kanjou Commission were once friends with Makoto and the Kitsune Saiguu. Although mere mortals, those who managed to survived back then were special individuals indeed.

401910812.text: ...Now I see why my officials claim that the hot springs facilitate conversation. Even I find myself divulging more than intended.

401910813.text: ...You're correct. Following the dark disaster five hundred years ago, a Nightmare engulfed Inazuma.

401910814.text: On a battlefield consumed in darkness, our soldiers fought against dark forces, creatures capable of possessing people and trapping them in nightmares. Even the Yumekui-Baku could do nothing to wake them.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the area outside the Aisa Bathhouse

401910904.text: It seems different in some respects... Step back and allow me to examine her.

401910907.text: What's going on... Ah! A—Almighty Shogun!

401910908.text: What happened just now? What frightened you?

401910910.text: It's alright. With the Shogun here, nothing can hurt you. Just take a deep breath and tell us what happened.

401910911.text: Phew... I almost fainted again just now...

401910912.text: Is that what happened earlier? You fainted?

401910913.text: Yes... I was on my way to Uyuu Restaurant, and as I was crossing the bridge, I saw someone staring at me from behind a tree!

401910914.text: It was hard to make out their appearance in the dark, but I had a bad feeling... So, I tried to get a closer look in the moonlight...

401910915.text: And, it was... It was me!

401910916.text: In that moment, I thought about how people who see their doppelganger usually end up dead, and I fainted from the shock... I don't remember anything after that...

401910917.text: A doppelganger? In Inazuma City? But, we only detected traces of the Nightmare around Mt. Yougou...

401910918.text: I heard that people encountered doppelgangers on Mt. Yougou, too! C—Could it be the work of some terrible youkai?

401910921.text: Now that we have an understanding of the situation, why don't I take you to the Police Station to file a report?

401910923.text: ...The situation is getting worse. If the doppelganger is limited to the festival grounds, that's one thing... But, appearing on a random street in Inazuma City...

401910924.text: Hm... On the bright side, the victim seems okay this time...

401910926.text: Hm? A Tenryou Commission official... What's wrong?

401910927.text: A—Another victim... at the... the festival... Kappa... Kappa is... trapped in a nightmare!

401910929.text: But... Sara and the others were keeping watch!

401910930.text: Make haste! Back to Mt. Yougou at once!

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the venue on Mt. Yougou

401912101.text: That's right! Because of the folk tale about doppelgangers, the culprit was able to incite panic without attacking anyone at all...

401912102.text: But, after the Tenryou commission secured the venue, the culprit appeared in Inazuma City so that the panic would spread.

401912103.text: But, what is the end goal? Panic doesn't seem like enough of a motive...

401912104.text: You're right, panic is a means to an end. But, I think the shift to Inazuma City proves something... Whatever their goal, terrorizing one location wasn't enough...

401912105.text: And, since Inazuma City is their new target, the person they're impersonating at the festival... should be absent...

401912106.text: Unless... the culprit found a way to cover their tracks and incite more panic...

401912110.text: K—Kappa is... Kappa is made of wood!?

401912111.text: No wonder I couldn't sense the nightmare!

401912112.text: I see... So, the doppelganger infiltrated the festival as Kappa and is currently hiding in Inazuma City... Is that correct?

401912113.text: ...Not just that. Replacing one person wasn't enough... If multiple people are replaced at once, they can cover for each other.

401912114.text: ...We didn't get to see each other much during the Test of Courage...

401912115.text: Kozou and his two friends were together the whole time, too. They would have noticed if someone was acting weird.

401912116.text: This kind of transformation is said to have a particular weakness... If the subject is frightened, the disguise starts to crumble. Isn't that right, "Youko" and "Hitotsume Kozou"?

401912124.text: Aren't you supposed to be in Inazuma City?

401912125.text: ...And leave you two by yourselves? That's not the Tanuki way!

401911101.text: Oh, you didn't go to the hot springs?

401911103.text: Ah, well... A whole crowd of people have left already. I'll go a bit later with Shousei and a few others.

401911104.text: Besides, we're a bit behind with our game. We need to catch up.

401911105.text: But, your team is the biggest...

401911106.text: Haha, I guess it's my fault for going overboard with the ideas. Kozou and the others can barely keep up.

401911107.text: Sometimes delegating work is harder than doing it yourself... I wonder if this is how he feels, being the head of the clan.

401911109.text: Of course! Right back at you!

401912401.text: (Looks like everyone's busy trying to finish their game... I should come back later.)

401912901.text: N—Nothing's working! The humans are catching up!

401911901.text: Well, Ioroi, as I see it, you've been punished long enough. It's about time you were released...

401911902.text: R—R—Released!? I can do that myself any time I want! This statue keeps me warm in the winter and cool in the summer. Don't interfere!

401911906.text: ...Besides, the seal's power is almost gone... What I really want is for you to help me give that sneaky kitsune a piece of my mind!

401911908.text: Not so fast! I won't be fooled by your tricks again! Whatever you were about to say, she can tell me herself, instead of sending some young kitsune to hoodwink me!

401912001.text: That's right, the entities appeared at the same time and place. That's why the Tenryou Commission conflated the two at first.

401912002.text: But, if we ignore the nightmare creature and look at the doppelganger incident in isolation... the culprit's motive is clear.

401912301.text: (Looks like everyone's busy trying to finish their game... I should come back later.)

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Kinkaku and the others

401911201.text: We... We're almost rid of them...

401911202.text: ...That's enough! I will not fail the Shogun again because of you!

401911204.text: Tengu was flying... Tengu is a cheater!

401911205.text: Surrender now, and I will spare your life.

401911206.text: Tengu... Why are you helping the humans! Tengu is a youkai!

401911207.text: *scoff*... My loyalty is to the Shogun. Humans and youkai are no different in my eyes.

401911208.text: Shogun... That's the leader of the humans!

401911209.text: ...Shogun sent people to steal our land... Shogun is bad!

401911210.text: Nonsense! The Shogun would never give such an order!

401911211.text: Calm yourself, Sara. Let's hear them out.

401911212.text: Shogun... sent humans to steal our home...

401911213.text: And the Mikawa Flower Festival! Shogun is making youkai serve the humans...!

401911214.text: Serve the humans? He's not talking about the game development, is he...?

401911215.text: *whimper*... Shogun even forced great baku youkai to work all night...

401911216.text: Oh... you mean yesterday? That was my choice, actually...

401911217.text: Geez, where are these ideas coming from?

401911221.text: Humans want to enslave us again!

401911222.text: Hold on, something's not right! We should try a different approach...

401911223.text: No need... I know what's wrong. They're trapped in a nightmare.

401911224.text: What are you doing...!? Trying to put Tetsunosuke to work!?

401911225.text: G—Ginkaku... doesn't wanna stay up all night... *whimper*...

401911226.text: Servitude, enslavement... These might sound like ridiculous misunderstandings to us. But, that is their reality right now.

401911227.text: ...A world of despair and fear, where enemies lurk at every turn... devoid of even a single shred of light.

401911228.text: So, they're... sleepwalking? How do we wake them up?

401911229.text: ...If we knew how, we would have done so back then.

401911230.text: G—Give us your worst! Kinkaku will never leave the Tanuki path! Kinkaku... Kinkaku will die before serving you!

401911602.text: *snore*... Keep it down... Bringing all these people at this hour... Don't you know even statues... need to... sleep...

401911603.text: Sh—Shogun! I bow before thee... No, wait... Shoot! I'm still a statue... What should I—

401911604.text: All is well, Ioroi, Hidden Protector of the Grove.

401911605.text: I've never seen Ioroi so afraid...

401911606.text: Ah, that would be because, when Ioroi tried to pluck a Naku Weed from the imperial garden, Ei nearly split him in two... Yashiori Island style...

401911607.text: ...Keep it to yourself, you meddlesome kitsune!

401911608.text: ...Ioroi, I wish to ask you something.

401911609.text: ...Anything, Shogun! Absolutely anything! It is my honor to answer!

401911611.text: Phew... You could have at least slowed down a little... It took forever to convince them to come with me...

401911616.text: Not... dead? The kitsune spoke the truth?

401911617.text: This smell... is Ioroi! Ioroi is alive?

401911618.text: Ioroi! The humans really did seal you away!

401911619.text: Wait, this must be... Kinkaku... Ginkaku.... and Tetsunosuke? You weren't sealed away?

401911620.text: Hmph... When the human, Kamuna Harunosuke, came to hurt us...

401911621.text: We ran and hid... The human searched and searched... So many friends couldn't move. Our youkai powers were getting weaker...

401911622.text: So, we decided to escape the human just as the great bake-danuki Tsukumo taught us — by digging a hole in the ground!

401911623.text: That's when we uncovered a horn filled with youkai power! It was the will of the great bake-danuki Giichiro made manifest!

401911624.text: It restored our power! And we made the human go thump thump, clang clang, slash slash!

401911625.text: Ooh! And by thump thump, clang clang, slash slash, you mean...

401911627.text: ...So, you didn't actually beat him up at all...

401911628.text: We've been using the horn to hide ever since... But, there are too many humans... It's getting harder to hide...

401911629.text: A horn full of youkai power... Could that be the source of the nightmares? The reason the bake-danuki are so afraid of humans?

401911630.text: If the horn contained the fragment of a nightmare, using its power to hide would spread the nightmare to them. That means, the bake-danuki have been trapped in this state of anxiety... for five hundred years...

401911631.text: Hah, I could have told you nothing good would come from that horn... Using external power is against the Tanuki path!

401911632.text: Eek! We... strayed from the path?

401911633.text: But... the horn helped us hide from the humans! The humans tried to take our land...

401911634.text: ...On the contrary, the purpose of the investigation was to determine in advance if youkai were present on the land in question.

401911635.text: Whether we avoid encroaching on youkai territory altogether or attempt to reach a mutually beneficial agreement, a peaceful resolution was always the goal.

401911637.text: Wait... that IS what the human said back then, isn't it...

401911638.text: ...By order of the shogun, if youkai live here, we need to discuss the proposal...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Miko and the others

401911301.text: Kinkaku, Ginkaku, Tetsunosuke... Not all humans are bad. Yellow Fur over there helped me a great deal, you know...

401911302.text: Besides, the bake-danuki were only sealed away back then because Ioroi stole that comb...

401911303.text: Ioroi... is a thief? Ioroi... got what he deserved?

401911304.text: ...H—H—How was I to know it was used to make Sacred Sakura Daifuku? I gave it back, didn't I!?

401911305.text: So, the humans were mean for no reason?

401911306.text: Well... if you must know, the young human and I fought... I was, perhaps, a tad careless, so I... conceded the match! Anyway, the point is... Neither side is bad!

401911307.text: There he goes again, changing the subject when it makes him look bad...

401911308.text: Now you know... No human is trying to harm you.

401911309.text: So... it was all a nightmare...

401911310.text: Five hundred years in hiding... for nothing...

401911311.text: ...Eh, it was a five-hundred-year-long game of Hide-and-Seek. What's so bad about that? Besides, you won.

401911312.text: Huh? We won? ...Go us! We're even better than Ioroi!

401911313.text: Hey! My game of Hide-and-Seek isn't over yet!

401911314.text: Wow, the mind of a bake-danuki is something else... Still so cheerful, even after all that...

401911315.text: That nature is what isolated them from the worst effects of the nightmare and prevented them from causing any real harm.

401911316.text: But, a nightmare that's still affecting people after all this time? Who could it belong to? Hm, a horn buried under Mt. Yougou...

401911317.text: I feel like I've heard a legend about that...

401911318.text: ...Tainted by darkness, the oni warrior raised her sword against the Almighty Shogun. Losing an arm and a horn to the Shogun's blade, she fled into the forest, never to be seen again.

401911319.text: ...A trusted lieutenant fighting against the forces of darkness, she was once devoured whole by a beast from beyond this world, with the body of a tiger and the tail of a serpent, until she tore the creature apart from within...

401911320.text: Thus, she earned the name, "Chiyo the Tiger-Bite"... Or, "Torachiyo."

401911321.text: I don't think... Chiyo would like that name.

401911322.text: Though she escaped the belly of the beast alive... That battle never left her.

401911323.text: She saw the memories of her fallen comrades everywhere, slaughtered one after another, until she could no longer distinguish dream from reality...

401911324.text: (A nightmare doesn't incapacitate someone with sufficient strength... It turns into something even worse...)

401911325.text: ...The nightmare twisted every joy in her life — her subordinates, family, and friends — into enemies in need of destruction.

401911326.text: It was in that state, trapped in the battlefield of her mind, that she raised her sword against me on Mt. Yougou.

401911327.text: With the Musou no Hitotachi, I cut off her arm, one of her horns, and a portion of the mountain itself... I suspect that is when the horn in question was buried there.

401911328.text: And, subsequently, uncovered by three bake-danuki... That means the fragment on the horn... comes from Chiyo's nightmare.

401911329.text: #Nightmares feed on fear and anxiety. If what {NICKNAME} saw is true...

401911330.text: It's possible Kinkaku and the others' fear over the past five hundred years allowed the fragment to gain physical form and become something akin to a jibakurei.

401911332.text: An earthbound spirit. They move through the Ley Lines, but are also bound by them. That's why the traces of this entity appeared intermittently, and never outside of Mt. Yougou.

401911333.text: It would seem the fragment of this Nightmare is no different from the one back then... It hates all joy and every good thing in this world.

401911334.text: The Investigation Team working for a better future? Attacked... Hitotsume Kozou and his friends, kind enough to lend a helping hand? Attacked...

401911335.text: Yeah, and we were attacked, too! Right when we were having fun with the play-testing...

401911336.text: So, why hasn't it appeared since?

401911337.text: Perhaps it needs to regain strength after your defeat... Or, perhaps it is biding its time because it knows, with whatever rationality remains, that it cannot defeat you...

401911338.text: ...But, sooner or later, its twisted hatred will force it out of hiding, and it will move to strike its "enemies."

401911339.text: When Chiyo set her sights on a target... She never was one to waver.

401911341.text: ...But, both possibilities prove something... Nightmare Fragments can be defeated.

401911342.text: And an enemy that can be killed... is one that can be split in two by the power of Musou Isshin.

401911344.text: Mikoshi Chiyo is gone. A fragment of a Nightmare tied to a severed horn... That is all that remains. The living must take precedent over the memory of the dead.

401911345.text: (Even so, having to unleash Musou Isshin against her again? Would Ei really be okay?)

401911346.text: (Mizuki said Archons suffer from the same turmoil as the rest of us... The dead may be gone, but that doesn't mean our emotions die with them...)

401911348.text: I'm just trying to look out for the living.

401911349.text: ...! What is that supposed to mean, Miko?

401911350.text: Oh, I'm just concerned about our poor bake-danuki friends...

401911351.text: Huh? What does this have to do with us?

401911352.text: The Nightmare Fragment has been tied to the bake-danuki for nearly five hundred years. Strike it down, and who's to say whether you take the lives of our poor friends along with it.

401911354.text: I... I beseech you, Almighty Shogun! S—Spare the young ones! It was just a momentary... Or, uh, no... a five-hundred-year long lapse in judgement...

401911356.text: #If you don't believe me, ask Mizuki and {NICKNAME}. I'm sure they've encountered similar cases during their extensive travels...

401911358.text: ...Yes! During my studies, both in Liyue and Natlan!

401911359.text: Yeah! I've definitely seen that happen before!

401911360.text: Then... What would you propose? This Nightmare Fragment is a constant threat to Inazuma. Should all other options fail... I will take action.

401911361.text: ...If the Fragment's hatred toward the world comes from a Nightmare, then the most logical option... is to get rid of the Nightmare itself...

401911362.text: Right! Can't you just eat the Nightmare, Mizuki?

401911363.text: ...The Yumekui-Baku already tried that five hundred years ago. Even yesterday, when faced with the corruption of the Nightmare, Mizuki could only mitigate the effects.

401911364.text: What was impossible back then... is not necessarily impossible now. I think Mizuki has the right idea. If we cannot eradicate the nightmares directly...

401911365.text: Why not use this entity's tricks against it? Combat illusions with illusions. Combat nightmares... with dreams.

401911367.text: Don't forget — there are youkai that specialize in shapeshifting and illusions, and they happen to be right in front of us.

401911368.text: Wh—Where? Kinkaku doesn't see them anywhere!

401911369.text: Maybe they're hiding as trees? Or the wind?

401911370.text: Fools! The kitsune is clearly referring to the bake-danuki! Tetsunosuke, Kinkaku, must you be so dense!?

401911371.text: Given their centuries-long connection to the Nightmare Fragment, they are perfectly positioned to create a dreamscape that the entity will be unable to distinguish from the real world.

401911372.text: ...Back then, the Nightmare had little to no weaknesses... If we want to give the bake-danuki an opportunity to strike, I assume you have a plan, Miko?

401911373.text: You said it yourself — Mikoshi Chiyo is gone. All that remains is a fragment of her nightmare, already broken and vulnerable.

401911374.text: Besides... Mizuki is an old friend, one that is not to be underestimated. She has traveled the land studying dreams and is far more capable than those old fossils back then.

401911377.text: She just... usually doesn't compliment me to my face... But, Miko's right. If we work together, I'm confident we can put together a ritual to subdue the Nightmare Fragment.

401911378.text: Once we perform the ritual, it will take some time for the barrier to take effect. Luckily for us, we have two formidable warriors on our side...

401911379.text: ...Our festival representative, who also happens to have extensive experience against dark forces, and the Almighty Shogun, unmatched in combat... I'm sure the two of you can buy us some time?

401911380.text: There's just one problem... Since this entity can pass through the Ley Lines, its movements are unpredictable. If we're going to create a barrier, how can we be sure it appears where we want?

401911381.text: Ah, the solution to that... is obvious. If the Nightmare Fragment despises all sources of joy and happiness...

401911382.text: Then, naturally, a joyous occasion would be an evil beyond measure — an enemy that must be annihilated at all costs...

401911383.text: So, if we want to lure it out...

401911387.text: Hehe, what joy could possibly compare to finishing one's work right before the deadline?

401911388.text: ...I would imagine we can all think of a few. But, I agree — the Mikawa Flower Festival is the most plausible target.

401911389.text: Once the enemy appears, I will pull them into the Plane of Euthymia immediately... I will not put the people in danger.

401911390.text: #{NICKNAME}, I ask that you join me there so we can subdue the enemy together.

401911392.text: Alright, I will update everyone back at the festival and start the preparations for the ritual... I'll need your help, Mizuki. It's going to be a busy night.

401911393.text: Looks like another all-nighter for me.

401911394.text: ...Well, this was your idea. Oh, and don't forget — you need to finish "A Little Fox's Daydream" as well.

401911395.text: ...And, in a surprising twist, you were my nightmare all along!

401911701.text: #{NICKNAME}... During the battle tomorrow, it is imperative you know your limits. If the enemy proves too much to handle... leave them to me.

401911703.text: I know... I understand your concerns, just as you know mine. We need not say any more than that. Just get some rest and prepare yourself for the battle to come.

401911707.text: Ah, one more thing... Thank you.

401911002.text: Excuse me, let me take a look!

401911004.text: Shogun! ...The fault is mine. The Tenryou Commission failed to protect those under our charge...

401911005.text: Now is not the time to cast blame. Did anyone witness the attack?

401911006.text: ...No, we have failed you. There is no trace of the enemy...

401911007.text: We split up for just a second, and the next thing we knew, he was on the ground!

401911008.text: *whimper*... It... It must be some terrible youkai...

401911009.text: Other than the bake-danuki transformation, there was no trace of youkai power at the scene... It's almost like the culprit's methods are getting more sophisticated.

401911012.text: Wait... there was a doppelganger in Inazuma City?

401911014.text: Doppelgangers... Nightmares... Inazuma City... Mt. Yougou...

401911016.text: It's strange... I can't perceive his nightmare. It's almost like... he's not there at all.

401911017.text: Th—The youkai... It must be getting stronger!

401911019.text: ...It's my fault! I should have anticipated the culprit might resort to more sophisticated methods...

401911020.text: No, it was I who underestimated the enemy... I who allowed us to continue the festival despite the potential dangers.

401911021.text: Sara, what is the status of the other contestants and staff?

401911022.text: ...All normal. I asked the Yashiro Commission to move them to a secure location just to be safe.

401911023.text: Good... By decree of the Shogun, I declare that the Mikawa Flower Festival is—

401911026.text: You're being too hasty, Ei. I understand your concern for the people, but I urge you to think this through, or we risk playing into the enemy's hand.

401911027.text: Considering your history with Nightmares, you have better cause than anyone to exercise caution... But, do you truly believe what we're facing now... is just a Nightmare?

401911029.text: Call it intuition... If you want the truth, perhaps Doushin Shikanoin could shed some light. I believe there's been a break in the case.

401911030.text: ...You flatter me, Lady Guuji. I do have a few ideas...

401911031.text: Up to this point, we've only detected traces of the nightmare creature around Mt. Yougou... And, now, a doppelganger appears in Inazuma City.

401911032.text: Our original thought was that the culprit infiltrated the venue to evade capture... If so, there would be no reason for them to risk exposure by continuing to change form.

401911033.text: Rather than concluding that the nightmare creature, on top of everything, now has the ability to disappear without a trace, I think there's a different possibility...

401911502.text: Not a problem. I'll wait here.

401911801.text: Great youkai really wasn't forced to work all night?

401911802.text: That's right. It was my choice.

401911803.text: Why does great youkai have to work?

401911804.text: ...I suppose it's just the price of becoming a great youkai.

401911805.text: Great youkai, Ginkaku is sad for you...

401912501.text: Interesting... The culprit's motive and method all seem rather self-contradictory. But, when did we first notice the dissonance...

401912601.text: It's rare to see the Almighty Shogun in such a good mood... Hmph, I will not let some wretched miscreant undermine the festival.

401912701.text: An enemy that has two different abilities and can suddenly appear and disappear without a trace... It seems too random, like a novel from Yae Publishing House that tries to incorporate every element under the sun.

401912702.text: The nightmare creature and the doppelgangers... are separate entities. That's why their methods are so different. They have separate goals.

401912703.text: The people who saw doppelgangers were mistaken and the nightmare I saw wasn't real... No, no. I can't just explain it away...

401912705.text: That doesn't sound right... I need to think about this some more.

401912801.text: We thought the culprit was changing form to evade capture... But, if the doppelganger isn't responsible for the nightmares, they would be no more deserving of arrest than a random prankster...

401912802.text: The doppelganger incident didn't actually hurt anyone... But, the folk tale about doppelgangers did cause people to panic... That must be the culprit's goal.

401912803.text: Taking control of Inazuma by replacing everyone with doppelgangers... I doubt even a folk tale would come up with something so unrealistic.

401912805.text: That doesn't sound right... I need to think about this some more.

401913001.text: (Looks like everyone's busy trying to finish their game... I should come back later.)

401919901.text: Man, what happened last night? We couldn't find anyone to discuss it with because it was so late... Well, Miko and the others should be at the grounds by now, right? Let's go talk to them!

401919902.text: Okay, so where do we start... We need to ask questions to figure out if there's an imposter, but we can't arouse suspicion...

401919903.text: Oh, looks like Sayu's team is already here. Well, guess we'll just... play it by ear.

401919904.text: Phew... Another day of hard work. Where did the time go...

401919905.text: Huh? When did Ei get ahead of us? Let's catch up!

401919906.text: Bake-danuki, those little terrors... C'mon, let's go after them!

401919907.text: Wait! We must be in the wrong spot! They probably didn't make it this far.
